findings.description:
StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#669-757) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- operatorReward = reward / (totalNumReceivers) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#695)
	- amounts[numInstances] = reward - (numInstances * operatorReward) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#706)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#669-757) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- receivers.length == 0 || receivers.length != amounts.length (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#733)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#669-757) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- rewardDistributionType == RewardDistributionType.ServiceMultisig (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#715)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#669-757) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- rewardDistributionType == RewardDistributionType.Proportional (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#682)

StakingBase._checkRatioPass(address,uint256[],uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#468-493) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- success && returnData.length == 32 (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#489)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#669-757) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- rewardDistributionType == RewardDistributionType.ServiceOwner (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#707)

StakingBase._getRewardReceiversAndAmounts(uint256,address,address,uint256,uint256) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#669-757) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- rewardDistributionType == RewardDistributionType.Proportional (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#682)
	- rewardDistributionType == RewardDistributionType.ServiceOwner (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#707)
	- rewardDistributionType == RewardDistributionType.ServiceMultisig (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#715)
	- receivers.length == 0 || receivers.length != amounts.length (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#733)
	- i_scope_0 < amounts.length (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#739)
	- receivers[i_scope_0] == address(0) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#741)
	- receivers[i_scope_0] == address(this) (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#746)
	- amountCheck != reward (dataset/positive/gold_standard/flattened/contracts/gs_039.sol#753)
